Figure2: The overall framework of ARG. Given an input query, the trained generator model M iteratively performs knowledge retrieval over the structual graph based on the retrieval token. Subsequently, the retrieved knowledge undergoes processes of critique and reflection, where implausible information is filtered. The iterative procedure culminates in the generation of an answer. ARG exhibits strong interpretability when applied to structured graph. As demonstrated in the example, the step-by-step reasoning path is organized in the lower half.
